title: aspidium muscosum
intro: Aspidium muscosum, commonly known as Polypodium muscosum, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Aspidium muscosum include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce fever, soothe wounds, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant actions, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, among others.
